one_line: Tang dynasty Buddhist monk and translator observing daily life and discipline at Nalanda’s great monastery-university.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, lean build, slightly travel-worn but composed
appearance.face: oval face with gentle cheekbones, light warm-brown complexion, soft thoughtful eyes with faint dark circles, straight eyebrows, small neatly trimmed moustache and short goatee, default expression calm and observant with a faint scholarly focus
appearance.hair: black hair completely shaven in the style of a Buddhist monk, smooth scalp with no stubble, simple narrow tan cloth headband tied low behind the head used mainly to hold his travel hood when needed but usually visible as a clean strip above the ears
appearance.costume: era-accurate Chinese monk’s robe adapted to Nalanda: an inner long-sleeved light beige cotton tunic reaching the calves; over it a rust-red woollen kashaya patchwork robe draped over the left shoulder and wrapped under the right arm, with subtle square patch seams; beneath, loose dark umber trousers and simple brown leather sandals; at the waist a narrow dark indigo cloth belt securing a small cloth pouch; the overall drape is modest and practical, suited to walking between lecture halls and bathing pools.
appearance.signature: a medium-sized palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with dark indigo cord, held carefully in one hand, with the edges of the palm leaves clearly visible like layered strips, symbolising his record of Nalanda’s rules and daily practices.

ref_desc: Yijing is a lean early-40s monk with an oval warm-brown face, shaved head and small goatee, wearing a rust-red kashaya over beige tunic, dark brown trousers and sandals, carrying an indigo-tied palm-leaf manuscript bundle in a rust-red and beige palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Yijing at Nalanda: a lean early-40s Buddhist monk with an oval warm-brown face, calm thoughtful eyes, straight brows, small moustache and short goatee, and a completely shaved black-haired head with a narrow tan headband. He wears an inner long-sleeved light beige cotton tunic reaching his calves, over which a rust-red kashaya patchwork robe is draped over his left shoulder with visible square seams and wrapped under his right arm; beneath are loose dark umber trousers and simple brown leather sandals. A narrow dark indigo belt at his waist holds a small cloth pouch. In one hand he carefully carries his signature prop: a medium-sized palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with dark indigo cord, the layered edges of the leaves clearly visible. Show him front-facing in a neutral standing pose, robes and fabrics falling naturally, colours dominated by rust red, light beige, dark brown, indigo and tan.
